content.rendered:
Septemner 13th 2014 James Cornibe

 


 Wedding DJ in the South Bay

 

Ceremony DJ Wedding (Timeline for Ceremonies)
1. Background music – Vitamin Quartet and Piano Guys
2. Seating of the parents-Officiant – Vitamin Quartet and Piano Guys
3. Groomsman/Bridesmaid, Best Man/Maid of Honor March (1pm) – Piano Guys – christina perri thousand years
4. Processional : Mark Knopfler – Once Upon A Time…Storybook Love (starting at the :36 mark if possible)
5. Vows (none)
6. Recessional Bride and Groom are Married Hitched Special Momments
that Last Forever! (no preference, standard is fine)
___________________________________________

Reception DJ – Music – (Timeline for Wedding Receptions)
1. Cocktail Hour  – no preference or songs from sections 5 and 8, just not the line dances or slow songs from those sections

There won’t be an official cocktail hour, we will be doing a wine/beer/champagne bar from 1:20-4:20.  We also won’t be doing an official dining time.   Several food displays will be set up ahead of when the guests arrive and there will also be hot appetizers walked through the room at 2:15 and 3:00

2. Arrival of the Wedding Party Grand Entrance – (1:45-2pm depending on how long pictures take) Kool & The Gang – Celebration
Announce –
Ms Juli Langosch & Mrs Nicole Simmons
Mr Kelly Grillot & Ms Coleen Jefferies
Newlyweds Applause
Mr & Mrs James Cornibe
3. 1st Dance – John Legend – All of Me
Wedding Party – Cupid – Cupid Shuffle after first minute invite other guests onto the floor to join in
Everybody Dances – Justin Timberlake – Suit and Tie  Unless you think the beat on this is too off. Let me know if you have a song you would suggest out of my below list, or another song.
4. Dance Music – Dancing
(in any order you want, feel free to mix up the songs between section 5 and 8)
Black Eyed Peas – I gotta feeling
    Sexy and I Know It – LMFAO
Love Shack – B52s
Moves Like Jagger – Maroon 5
     Thrift Shop – Macklemore
Hey Ya – Outkast
Tricky – Run DMC
Sexy back – Justin Timberlake
    Cha Cha Slide – DJ Casper
    Love Story – Taylor Swift
    Dynamite – Taio
Timber – Pitbull/Kesha
Ice Ice Baby – Vanilla Ice
Blurred Lines – Robin Thicke
Good Feeling – Flo Rida
Play That Funky Music – Wild Cherry
Can’t Hold Us – Macklemore
Firework – Katy Perry
    Gucci Gucci – Kreayshawn
Beauty and a Beat – Justin Bieber & Nicki Minaj

5. Toast Best Man Maid of Honor Speech …  (no preference) (3:30)
Toast Groom – Eric Clapton – Wonderful Tonight
6. Bouquet Toss – Aqua – Barbie Girl
Garter Toss – Sugar Hill Gang – Apache Jump On It
7. Cake Cutting – KC & JoJo – All My Life
8. Dance Music – Dancing
(in any order you want, feel free to mix up the songs between section 5 and 8)
Scream and Shout – Will.I.am & Brittney Spears
Cotton Eyed Joe – Rednex
YMCA – Village People
Low – Flo rida
On The Floor – J. Lo/Pitbull
Party in the MIA – Leslie Limberg
This is How We Do It – Montel Jordan
Stand Up and Get Crunk – Ying Yang Twins
     Eternal Flame – Bengals
OMG – Will.I.am & Usher
    Electric Boogie (Slide) – Marcia Griffiths
    Lets Get It Started – Black Eyed Peas
Applause – Lady GaGa
     One More Time – Daft Punk
Humpty Dance – Digital Underground
C’mon ‘n ride it – Quad City DJ’s
Blasé Blasé – Kreayshawn
Express Yourself – Madonna
 9. Last Dance Song of the Night – Louis Armstrong – Kiss to Build a Dream On
Bride & Groom Thank Their Guests
Departure – Semisonic – Closing Time

DO NOT PLAY.

Cannon in D
